name: bluechonk-plugins
description: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

description_i18n.zh-CN: bluechonk 的 ZCode 插件市场。

plugins.name: deepseek-web-search
plugins.description: DeepSeek official web search and page fetch: zero-dependency CLI plus matching commands, skills and MCP servers.

description_i18n.en: DeepSeek official web search and page fetch: zero-dependency CLI plus matching commands, skills and MCP servers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: DeepSeek 官方联网搜索与网页抓取：零依赖 CLI，并配套 command、skill 与 MCP 服务。

plugins.name: todo-guard
plugins.description: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.

description_i18n.en: Todo discipline for ZCode: checks that task decomposition and progress updates actually use TodoWrite, and that a list rewrite was preceded by TodoRead. Advisory only, produces no files.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 待办纪律核对：确保任务拆解与进度更新真的用上了 TodoWrite，且重写清单前先做过 TodoRead。只提示不阻断，不产生任何文件。

plugins.name: security-review
plugins.description: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using.

description_i18n.en: Pattern-based security warnings on edits, plus an end-of-turn LLM review of the turn's git diff run against the model ZCode is currently using.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 编辑后即时做安全模式检查；每轮收尾时用 ZCode 当前在跑的模型审查本轮的 git diff。

plugins.name: repo-guardian
plugins.description: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, .gitattributes, README language, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.

description_i18n.en: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, .gitattributes, README language, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus code and comment rule lint after every write.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 仓库健康检查与本机规则执行：CI 有无、.gitattributes、README 语言、禁用命令、emoji 与临时文件落点，以及写入后的代码与注释规范核对。

plugins.name: pua-bridge
plugins.description: Bridges PUA's Claude Code command hooks into ZCode: session flavor restore, frustration triggers, integrity guard, failure detection, loop state machine, subagent accounting and pre-compact checkpoints.

description_i18n.en: Bridges PUA's Claude Code command hooks into ZCode: session flavor restore, frustration triggers, integrity guard, failure detection, loop state machine, subagent accounting and pre-compact checkpoints.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 PUA 的 Claude Code 命令钩子接进 ZCode：会话风味恢复、不满触发、完整性守卫、失败检测、loop 状态机、子代理会计与压缩前检查点。

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: freely accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then run a triage session to split them into clean topic branches with rewritten commit messages and sequenced pull requests.

description_i18n.en: Exploratory development wrap-up flow: freely accumulate wip commits on a dev branch, then run a triage session to split them into clean topic branches with rewritten commit messages and sequenced pull requests.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 探索式开发的收口流程：dev 分支上随意积累 wip 提交，定期开整理会把累积提交按主题拆成干净的主题分支并重写提交信息，再按依赖顺序逐个 PR。
